firm_data.firm_description: FisherBroyles was the first and is among the largest distributed law firms in the world. Our distributed model was built to eliminate the inefficiencies and overhead that burden traditional firms.
notable_facts: First distributed law firm to be ranked by The American Lawyer as one of the 200 largest law firms by revenue
